Batch of 10 run analyses (bug-fix ×5, dead-code-sweep ×3, operator ×1, software-delivery ×1), analyzedAt 2026-09-17 → 2026-10-05, analyst scores 52–82. All 10 runs reached `complete`; one (wf_bug_TEAM-5259) was cancelled and re-labelled complete with the fix undeployed.

The common thread is **human gates that gated nothing**: 4 bug-fix runs paged an engineer to ACCEPT a ≤P2 review residual (97,053,681 ms combined; every decision was ACCEPT, none changed the outcome); 2 empty dead-code sweeps held a Merge Approval for a PR that did not exist (38,293,632 ms, 87–95 % of wall); 3 escalation gates on TEAM-5259 were closed from the console with no DECISION (36,548,856 ms, 80.5 % of wall) and the agents proceeded as if un-answered; 1 deploy gate was "Approved via Telegram" with no deploy performed (4,555,621 ms to recover). Separately, one CD ticket that had already shipped to prod was re-dispatched 8 times ($40.92 of $73.99) because the nudger ignored both `dead_session_retry_exhausted` and an explicit Workflow Manager escalate.

Pipeline mechanics were otherwise healthy across the batch: `missed_rewake_gaps` 0.0 (5 runs since 2026-09-14), 0 missed re-wakes in all 10 analyses, skip cascade for agent tickets confirmed working (33rea7, f7jj7j: 5–6 tickets skipped in ≤6 s vs fz514x 31.7 h).

## Prior attempts

`si_verify.py` (dry run, 2026-10-05T17:08Z) — reproduced verbatim:

> No expectation is ready to judge (26 ledger rows, 0 pending). Nothing is ruled on until an attempt has shipped.
>
> ## analysis_coverage
>
> 36.8% of 19 terminal runs in the rolling 14-day window.

No pattern in this PRD has a shipped attempt with a verdict. None of the four deliverables below re-files a key that is `in-run`, `landed`/`deployed` <14 d, or `wont-fix`.

## Dedupe gate

| patternKey | ledger status | filed here? |
|---|---|---|
| `orchestrator.skip-cascade.human-gate` | open | yes — D1 |
| `blueprint.rework-loop` | open | yes — D2 |
| `pipeline.deploy-gate` | open | yes — D3 |
| `orchestrator.redispatch-loop` | open | yes — D4 |
| `hub.tickets-lambda.outage` | open | yes — D4 |
| `harness.silent-death` | **in-run** (TEAM-4734, wf_1789671047405_e19l5v, PRD system-20260917T185043) | **no** — dbf595 Bedrock 5xx exit and TEAM-4711 ci_agent status-OK death are cited as evidence only |
| `pipeline.ci-flake` | landed (TEAM-4448) — awaiting verdict | no (not cited in this batch) |
| `metrics.card.time-blind-spot`, `ops.self-heal.circular`, `orchestrator.cascade-gap`, `blueprint.evidence-missing`, `gate.human-wait`, `qa.live-env.cross-account-access`, `intake.scope`, `metrics.human-wait.overcount`, `tickets.duplicate` | open | deferred — over the 4-deliverable cap; see "Deferred" below |

## Gaps (evidence)

### G1 — Empty-sweep skip cascade stops at the human Merge Approval gate (`orchestrator.skip-cascade.human-gate`, n=2 in 7 days)

- wf_1790592080841_33rea7 (juno, analysis 1790610898871-d844): TEAM-5204 reported `empty_sweep` 10:56:34Z; TEAM-5205/5206/5207/5208/5210/5211 all Done'd `evidence_kind=skipped reason=empty_sweep` within 6 s. TEAM-5209 (human:engineer Merge Approval) instead received `review.needed` at 10:56:43Z, unblockedBy the *skipped* TEAM-5208, and held **17,460,387 ms (4.85 h, 95 % of 18,386,949 ms wall)** for a PR that did not exist (prUrl ''). Card 100/A.
- wf_1791195796673_f7jj7j (agentcore-hub, analysis 1791219987753-3vqd): identical shape. TEAM-5287 `review.needed` 11:12:48Z unblockedBy TEAM-5286 `{skipped:true, reason:empty_sweep}`; waitMs **20,833,245 (5.79 h, 87.5 % of 23,808,358 ms wall)**; outcome approved; nothing to approve. Card 100/A.
- Root cause: the cascade Done's agent tickets but treats the Ship ticket's skip as an ordinary unblock of the gate; `reviewGates[Merge Approval].condition` is `always`, so the gate fires with the gated deliverable absent.

### G2 — Review round cap escalates ≤P2 residuals to a human; every decision was ACCEPT (`blueprint.rework-loop`, n=4 consecutive real bug-fix runs)

| run | gate | waitMs | residual | decision | outcome changed? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| wf_bug_TEAM-4711 (hy39) | TEAM-4722 | 32,380,695 (9.0 h overnight; 57 % of wall) | R3-1 P2 "no money at risk, not a regression" | ACCEPT via Telegram | no |
| wf_bug_TEAM-4726 (pdrp) | TEAM-4748 | 74,064 | R3-F7 P3 | ACCEPT | no |
| wf_bug_TEAM-5038 (74ks) | TEAM-5079 | 59,624,903 (16.6 h; 69 % of 86,444,481 wall) | two P3s | "(a) accept as is" | no — ship-review r1 then re-found the accepted P3 as P2 (TEAM-5142, PR #733) because the acceptance lived only in the human's DECISION line |

Combined **97,053,681 ms (~27 h)** of human wait that bought nothing. `recommendation_recurrence(blueprint.rework-loop)` = 31.43 over the last 7 runs — the most re-filed key in the ledger. The def config today is `maxRounds 3, onCapReached: escalate` with no severity floor and no persistence of accepted residuals.

### G3 — Human gates close without a decision / without the post-condition (`pipeline.deploy-gate`, n=2 runs, 4 gates)

- wf_bug_TEAM-5259: all 3 human gates closed "Manual override from console", no `DECISION:` line, no access change — TEAM-5273 4,974,019 ms, TEAM-5278 21,343,056 ms, TEAM-5279 5,776,854 ms = **36,548,856 ms (80.5 % of wall)** decided nothing; each close spawned the next ticket (TEAM-5274, TEAM-5279) and the run was finally cancelled → relabelled complete with 9 tickets force-Done and the fix undeployed.
- wf_1790014803133_1ykx9f (q6of): deploy gate TEAM-4931 resolved 23:53:44Z "Approved via Telegram" with the deploy **not performed** (PR #8 open, main at f5acfd84, build echoing old buildspec); QA had to prove it and open escalation TEAM-4939, **4,555,621 ms** lost. Workflow then completed 03:21:28Z with gate TEAM-4954 still `in_review` on human:engineer.
- Related (`gate.human-wait`): wf_bug_TEAM-5038 TEAM-5148 second deploy approval fired with `preapproval.recorded=false (rejection_unverified)` after TEAM-5045 approved the same SHA — 524,848 ms.
- `recommendation_recurrence(pipeline.deploy-gate)` = 20.0 over 7 runs; 4th sighting of the approve-without-action class (0911 approval-to-merge drift, 0912 Telegram approval untracked ×3, now 4931/4939 and 5273/5278/5279).

### G4 — Nudge/reconcile re-dispatched a finished CD ticket 8 times; escalate ignored; control-plane outage invisible for 62.5 h (`orchestrator.redispatch-loop`, `hub.tickets-lambda.outage`, n=1 run, critical)

- wf_bug_TEAM-4783 (o05o): TEAM-4793 invocation #1 merged PR #591 (af996e9a) and hub-juno-deploy 4b7d9ae6 succeeded 2026-09-19T04:06:18Z. `report_completion` ×3 and WM `mark-done` all API 500 `Cannot find module /var/task/gate-contract.mjs` — the hub tickets/WorkflowOutput Lambda bundle was broken for **every** transition until 2026-09-21T18:38:32Z (~62.5 h; run wall 242,322,814 ms, ~227 M of it this tail).
- Loop: `agent.escalated dead_session_retry_exhausted` (05:15, 07:07, 08:15, 19:29, 20:06 09-19; 00:30 09-20; 18:17 09-21) → `workflow.nudge` → unblocked→ready → re-invoke, **8 futile re-dispatches, $40.92 of $73.99 (55 % of run cost)**, 5 false `agent.died` whose `lastText` each read "CD: SHIPPED; ticket close BLOCKED on hub infra (invocation #N)" with persisted `cd-evidence/BLOCKED-TEAM-4793-ticket-lambda-down.md`.
- WM `escalate` at 04:27:10Z said "DONE in reality — Do NOT re-dispatch"; 7 further nudges followed. WM `file-bug` TEAM-4821 auto-fired wf_bug_TEAM-4821, which needed the broken Lambda to create its own chain → cancelled (`ops.self-heal.circular`).

## Deliverables

### D1 (P0) — Skip cascade reaches human gates; a gate whose deliverable is absent is skipped, never `review.needed`
**patternKey:** `orchestrator.skip-cascade.human-gate` · **area:** orchestrator cascade correctness (DL-009) + dead-code-sweep def

1. In the skip cascade, when a ticket is Done'd as `skipped` (any `reason`, currently `empty_sweep`), every ticket whose `blockedBy` resolves entirely to skipped/Done-skipped tickets — **including tickets assigned `human:*`** — is Done'd with `evidence_kind=skipped`, same `reason`, and the gate is **never** transitioned to `in_review`; no `review.needed` event, no Telegram/approval page.
2. `reviewGates[].condition` gains a deliverable predicate: the dead-code-sweep Merge Approval gate (and Deploy Approval) changes from `condition: always` to `condition: deliverable_present(kind=pr)`; a gate whose condition is false at unblock time is Done'd as skipped with `reason=deliverable_absent`.
3. `workflow.complete` on a fully-skipped chain records `outcome=empty_sweep` (not `delivery=cd`) so the card and analyses can tell "swept, empty" from "shipped".

**Acceptance:** replay 33rea7 / f7jj7j event logs in the orchestrator test-suite → 0 `review.needed` emitted, TEAM-5209/TEAM-5287-class gates Done'd ≤10 s after the sweeper's `report_completion`; next empty sweep on hub or juno closes with `humanWaitMs = 0`; an analysis of that run does not cite `orchestrator.skip-cascade.human-gate`.

### D2 (P0) — Round-cap severity floor in the bug-fix def + persisted accepted residuals
**patternKey:** `blueprint.rework-loop` · **area:** workflow-def `reviewGates[0]` policy + review/ship-review tool state (DL-011 — **no orchestrator code**)

1. `reviewGates[0]` (bug-fix def; apply the same block to software-delivery/operator review gates) gets `onCapReached: { floor: P2, action: pass_with_followups }`: at `maxRounds`, if every open finding is ≤P2 and none is a regression-of-fix, the reviewer's completion is **PASS** and the residuals are written as `followUps[]` (`blockedBy=[CD]` where a CD ticket exists; PR-body "Known limitations" + backlog ticket in handoff repos). Only a P0/P1 or a regression-of-fix residual produces the `human:engineer` escalation ticket.
2. Whichever way the cap resolves (auto-PASS or human ACCEPT), the accepted residuals are persisted to `shared/ship-review-state.json` (`acceptedResiduals[]`: finding id, severity, rationale, decidedBy) and the ship-review tool loads them so a residual accepted at review is not re-filed as a ship-review fix (TEAM-5038 → TEAM-5142 shape).
3. A round-cap resolution is recorded as a rework round in the ticket metadata so the card's loop count includes it (compute_metrics already reads fix tickets; this only makes the cap visible).

**Acceptance:** replay TEAM-4711 / TEAM-4726 / TEAM-5038 / TEAM-5259 round-3 states → 0 escalation tickets, 4 PASS completions with followUps; a P1 residual at the cap still escalates; `ship-review-state.json` carries `acceptedResiduals[]` and ship-review r1 on the same head files no fix ticket for them.

This is the fourth consecutive re-raise of this ask (knowledge/bug-fix.md "re-raised ×4"); it has never been filed, so there is no failed attempt to design around — but the approach deliberately changes the **def policy and the review tool's state**, not the reviewer prompt, because the prompt-level "be lenient at the cap" ask is what the agent SI loop has been carrying without effect on the escalation count.

### D3 (P0) — Human gates are decision-bound: no Done without a DECISION, no deploy-gate close without its post-condition
**patternKey:** `pipeline.deploy-gate` · **area:** gate contract (`gate-contract.mjs` in the hub tickets Lambda) + console/Telegram approval handlers

1. **Decision contract.** When a `human:*` ticket body carries a `DECISION:` contract (the escalation/gate templates already emit one with enumerated options), the tickets Lambda **refuses** the `→ Done` transition unless a comment or the resolution payload contains a `DECISION: <option>` line matching one of the options. The console "Manual override" control must pick an option (default none) and writes `DECISION: override:<option>` as the resolving comment, so the waiting agent always has something to act on. A close with no decision re-opens the ticket and re-pages with the options.
2. **Post-condition for deploy / console-handoff gates.** `console_handoff` and `Deploy …` gate tickets carry a machine-checkable `postCondition` (PR merged SHA / CloudFormation `UPDATE_COMPLETE` / Lambda version / pipeline execution id). On "Approved", the orchestrator verifies the post-condition before unblocking dependants; if unmet after a bounded wait (10 min) it re-opens the gate as `approved_unverified` with the probe output, instead of letting QA discover it (1ykx9f TEAM-4931 → TEAM-4939).
3. **Pre-approval accounting.** `start_deploy` records `preapproval.recorded=true` whenever the Merge Approval for the identical SHA is Done with a DECISION; `rejection_unverified` must log the reason (TEAM-5148).
4. `workflow.complete` must not fire while any same-epic ticket assigned `human:*` is `in_review`/`ready` (1ykx9f TEAM-4954 open at completion) — completion correctness, DL-009.

**Acceptance:** attempting to close a DECISION-contract ticket from the console without choosing an option is rejected (API 409 + UI message); replay TEAM-5273/5278/5279 → each close carries a `DECISION:` line and no follow-on ticket is spawned by an "unanswered" close; a deploy gate approved with PR unmerged re-opens within 10 min as `approved_unverified`; a run with an open `human:*` gate cannot emit `workflow.complete`.

### D4 (P0) — Escalated / retry-exhausted tickets stay parked; re-dispatch cap; blocked ≠ dead; tickets-Lambda deploy smoke + out-of-band alarm
**patternKeys:** `orchestrator.redispatch-loop`, `hub.tickets-lambda.outage` · **area:** orchestrator dispatch/reaper correctness (DL-009) + hub infra CD

1. **Park flag honoured by the nudger.** `agent.escalated dead_session_retry_exhausted` and `manager.escalation` set `parked=true` (`parkedReason`, `parkedAt`) on the ticket; `workflow.nudge` and reconcile-sweep skip `unblocked→ready` for parked tickets until a human or the WM clears the flag (`intervene.py retry/unstick` clears it explicitly).
2. **Hard cap.** At most 3 orchestrator re-invocations of one ticket without an intervening human/WM action; the 4th attempt emits `agent.escalated reason=redispatch_cap` and parks.
3. **Blocked ≠ dead.** Before the reaper classifies a session dead, it checks for a persisted blocked record (`agents/<agent>/<ticket>-blocked-*.json`, `cd-evidence/BLOCKED-*.md`) or a streamed `lastText` verdict matching `SHIPPED|BLOCKED`; if present it emits `agent.blocked` (with reason) instead of `agent.died`, does not count a retry, and parks per (1).
4. **Tickets-Lambda deploy smoke + alarm.** The hub CD step imports the handler bundle (catches `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, the exact TEAM-4783 fault) and performs one no-op transition against a canary ticket **before** shifting the alias; a CloudWatch alarm on Lambda 5xx/error-rate > 0 for 5 min pages the out-of-band channel (Telegram/SMS), never a Jira ticket (the Lambda is what writes Jira).

**Acceptance:** replay TEAM-4783 events → exactly 1 invocation after the first `agent.escalated`, 0 further `agent.invoked` on TEAM-4793, final state `parked` with `agent.blocked`; a bundle missing one module fails the deploy before alias shift in a CI test; the alarm fires in a fault-injection test with the Lambda returning 500 and delivers out of band.

## Agent-level observations (for the agent SI loop — NOT deliverables)

- **bug_fixer / code_reviewer — stateful fixes without a lifecycle table (n=10 runs, dominant agent-level pattern in this batch):** TEAM-4711 (3 of 4 loops fix-induced), TEAM-4726 (3 rounds on the fix's own reconcile state machine), TEAM-5038 (3 of 5 loops), TEAM-5259 (r1 5/5 fix-induced, r2 3/4 resurfacing F3-class). Ask: fixer enumerates each new state's lifecycle + one test per row; reviewer rejects a stateful fix without it in round 1. This is the single largest *rework* cost in the batch and the eval loop should be seeing it — if it is not, the evals are missing these runs.
- **code_reviewer — incremental sibling sweep / late findings:** TEAM-5259 R2-4, R3-1 ("should have caught in round 1"); TEAM-4711 R3-1 manufactured round 3; TEAM-5038 three P3 rounds while the stated narrow-viewport criterion went untested (QA found it). `review.sibling-sweep.incremental`, `qa.verification-gap`.
- **requirements_analyst — intake does not flag "fix implies new state" (TEAM-4711, TEAM-4726) and dispatches full dead-code chains on a zero/one-commit delta (33rea7, f7jj7j; `intake.scope`, 11th sighting).**
- **code_sweeper — "never merge" rule misread as covering the integration branch (x1anpp PR #756; `blueprint.delivery.integration-branch-unmerged`); no ledger row on empty sweep (33rea7).**
- **operator — environment blocker surfaced only at the Merge gate (dbf595, `operator.blocker.late-escalation`); persona context bloat $26.77 on 24.6 M input tokens (`cost.persona.context-bloat`).**
- **Harness (in-run, not re-filed):** dbf595 session died on Bedrock `ConverseStream` internalServerException 98 s after start (no retry, WATCH retry 13 min later); TEAM-4711 ci_agent span closed status=OK with no `report_completion` (17.5 min lost). Both are `harness.silent-death` evidence for the in-flight TEAM-4734 run.

## Deferred (filable, over the 4-deliverable cap — first candidates for the next cycle)

- `metrics.card.time-blind-spot` (n=3 in batch: 33rea7 100/A vs 68, f7jj7j 100/A vs 66, TEAM-5259 84/B vs 52 on a cancelled undeployed run; recurrence 4.29): card needs a time/deliverable component, `ci=pass` only on a real certified head, cancelled cap survives operator close-out. D1(3) and D3(4) remove two of its triggers.

- `orchestrator.cascade-gap` (TEAM-5259 5 ship_fix follow-ups force-Done; TEAM-5038 post-CD advisory merged into the already-shipped branch, PR #736 stranded).
- `blueprint.evidence-missing` (TEAM-5038: Jira 400 under Bug-type parent killed 3 sessions, ~41 min; TEAM-5099).
- `gate.human-wait` (x1anpp 15,628,474 ms in-hours for an 11-line PR; TEAM-4783 6,997,259 ms off-hours rubber stamp): WATCH eligibility for `human:*` parks after 4 h.
- `qa.live-env.cross-account-access` (TEAM-5259 28,580,661 ms park; TEAM-4711 448,581 ms): cross-account role or staging deploy for QA.
- `metrics.human-wait.overcount` (TEAM-4726, TEAM-4783, TEAM-5038, 1ykx9f): split gate wait from escalation park; watchdog keyed on `lastStreamAt`.
